title: Photocatalytic degradation performance of a chitosan/ZnO–Fe3O4 nanocomposite over cationic and anionic dyes under visible-light irradiation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,1590-1603
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08262A, Paper

B. M. Quy, N. T. N. Thu, V. T. Xuan, N. T. H. Hoa, N. T. N. Linh, V. Q. Tung, V. T. T. Le, T. T. Thao, N. T. K. Ngan, P. T. Tho, N. M. Hung, L. T. Ha
The CS/ZnO–Fe3O4 nanoparticles synthesized by chemical ultrasound with large surface area can effectively decompose RhB and MO dyes under visible light, with degradation rates of 99.49% and 90.73%, respectively, and can be reused many times.
